items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Jonah Jones, before he got his break, he was thinkin' about becomin' a bank guard

ctx.x: I was going to ask way back. Other ways of getting by, financially: Did you ever take jobs other than jobs as a musician?

No, I never did. No, I never did that because...you know...I know some guys that did but, you know, it seems to take away. I don't know, if you have to do it, you have to do it. But it seemed to take away from me and I didn't think I had the temperament for that type of thing. But I guess if things had really got real, real, real bad I would have done that too, you know. 'Cause I know other guys that did, there was a lot of guys that became delegates to the union and some guys, like Hilton Jefferson, he became a…
know, before you have to make a decision like that, you know what I mean.
